name: io.github.tonyyang0504/freelancehunt-mcp
description: Freelancehunt (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting, list_messages, send_message. Every tool map

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCEHUNT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API token from https://freelancehunt.com/my/api2, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FREELANCEHUNT_SAFE_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Default payment protection for new bids: split, employer, developer or employer_cashless (Safe), per the 'Add bid' docs; leave unset for the platform default.
